headline: Nigerian Naira Stabilizes at N1,350 per Dollar Following US Fed Decision
summary: The Nigerian naira defended its N1,350 per US dollar baseline, supported by transmission channels following the Federal Reserve's decision to hold benchmark interest rates steady.
why: Stability in Nigeria's foreign exchange rate is critical for managing import inflation and encouraging foreign portfolio investment inflows.

impacts.name: USD/NGN
impacts.why: The currency maintained stability at N1,350/$ after the Fed rate announcement.
